summary: BiomX Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a new business strategy and expansion into defense, security, and critical infrastructure markets through the acquisitions of DFSL and Zorronet. The filing lacks specific terms such as price per share, premium, or implied value. The company intends to seek stockholder approval and expects to provide credit lines. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing serves as a comprehensive update superseding prior business descriptions. Watch for stockholder vote details and NYSE American listing compliance; risk-arb focus on integration and capital raising.
